notes: "For the first connection, open Agent setup at the top of the editor, choose the client and follow its setup instructions. Ask the assistant to read the project and selected page, then check the returned project name and Slide ID. Different assistants use native integrations with the same document contract. The plugin carries guidance; the connector binds requests to the explicitly chosen project. The Editor and assistants save through the shared writer. The marks identify supported routes, not models currently online. A real read and task are still needed to verify the selected project and access."

designIntent.purpose: For the first connection, open Agent setup at the top of the editor, choose the client and follow its setup instructions
keep: Keep actual product captures, original scientific data/assets, attribution and the demonstrated function. Do not fragment ordinary prose into a fake table.
designIntent.requestedChange: Explain the product and its use; interpret the founder’s account to choose the emphasis.
